create_symbol_database: create a SymbolDatabase instance and register protobuf file descriptors, messages, enums, and services
test_GetSymbol: test the SymbolDatabase GetSymbol method to look up a registered message by its fully qualified name
test_GetMessages: test the SymbolDatabase GetMessages method to retrieve all registered messages for a given proto file
test_GetPrototype: test the SymbolDatabase GetPrototype method to get the message class from a descriptor
test_FindMessageTypeByName: test the descriptor pool FindMessageTypeByName method to locate a registered message type by name
